subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should this PR land as the scoped bootstrap-context mitigation after clean exact-head gates, despite the intentional fs.glob replacement and bootstrap hook scheduling tradeoff?
rationale: The patch appears correct for the focused stall, but it changes compatibility-sensitive bootstrap glob traversal and hook scheduling behavior that tests cannot fully settle for existing user configs and session context bytes.

options.title: Land Scoped Mitigation After Gates
options.body: Accept the compatibility and session-state tradeoff as the right fix for the reported event-loop stall once exact-head CI is clean.

options.title: Require Connected Runtime Proof
options.body: Ask for a live embedded_run or channel proof showing bootstrap-context no longer starves message delivery before merge.

options.title: Pause For Broader Architecture
options.body: Defer this PR in favor of a larger worker/offload design, leaving the narrower bootstrap-context stall unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Mitigation After Gates
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility and session-state tradeoff as the right fix for the reported event-loop stall once exact-head CI is clean.
